name: Confluent Cloud Metrics
description: New Relic Flex integration config for Confluent Cloud Metrics API. Configure via New Relic Infrastructure agent Flex integration or Confluent Cloud integration tile.
note: Configure via New Relic Infrastructure agent Flex integration or Confluent Cloud integration tile. The CC_METRICS_API_KEY_BASE64 value is the Base64 encoding of CC_METRICS_API_KEY:CC_METRICS_API_SECRET.
